description.en: A list of cluster IDs, separated by commas.
The ID of the Service Mesh instance.

description.zh:
服务类型，取值：

- `ServiceEntry`：为服务网格ServiceEntry中注册的服务

- `Kubernetes`：为数据面Kubernetes集群注册的服务
description.en:
The type of the service. Valid values:

- `ServiceEntry`: a service registered in the Service Mesh by a service entry.

- `Kubernetes`: a service registered in a Kubernetes cluster on the data plane.

title.zh: 获取注册到网格内的服务端点信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh get-registered-service-endpoints --service-mesh-id c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --namespace default --cluster-ids c8b054ee8c3914d079b5ce97333280000,c58faedb8a78640d3aeb0372e4c020000 --name reviews --service-type Kubernetes --region cn-hangzhou
